description: This header file defines private data structures, function prototypes, and type declarations for handling YAML parser events in the fyaml project. It includes definitions for event management, memory allocation, and interaction with other parser components.

methods.name: fy_eventp_alloc
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new fy_eventp structure.

methods.name: fy_eventp_free
methods.description: Frees a previously allocated fy_eventp structure.

methods.name: fy_eventp_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the given fy_eventp, called internally.

methods.name: fy_parse_eventp_alloc
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new parse event pointer.

methods.name: fy_parse_eventp_recycle
methods.description: Recycles a parse event pointer for reuse.

methods.name: fy_emit_eventp_alloc
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new emit event pointer.

methods.name: fy_emit_eventp_recycle
methods.description: Recycles an emit event pointer for reuse.

methods.name: fy_parse_eventp_clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of a parse event pointer, optionally stripping anchors.

methods.name: fy_event_get_and_clear_anchor_token
methods.description: Retrieves and clears the anchor token from a given event.

methods.name: fy_event_get_anchor
methods.description: Returns the anchor string from a YAML event, along with its length.

methods.name: fy_document_iterator_eventp_alloc
methods.description: Allocates an event pointer for a document iterator.

methods.name: fy_document_iterator_eventp_recycle
methods.description: Recycles a document iterator event pointer.

methods.name: fy_document_iterator_event_create
methods.description: Creates a new event for a document iterator with specified type and data.

methods.name: fy_document_iterator_event_vcreate
methods.description: Creates a new event with variable arguments for a document iterator.

methods.name: fy_document_iterator_event_free
methods.description: Frees an event associated with a document iterator.
